Drop photographs in this folder and they appear in the "Building Leaders for
Tomorrow" strip on the home page, in filename order — no code change needed.

  01-campus.jpg
  02-counseling.jpg
  03-graduation.jpg

Numbering the files controls the order. JPEG or WebP, about 1200-1600px on the
long edge is plenty; the strip renders them 176-256px tall.

While this folder is empty the strip falls back to the site's existing
photographs, so the section is never blank.
